title: fix(metadata-protocol, metadata)!: the bare read of an action name weighs its package-less holder, and serves the one enabled holder when a disabled package registered first (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgE7H9rqBRyJrrxa5bm7JWa7)_
epic:#31527#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZJg15nkBQ9JewJsNS

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：不带包名按名读取动作（`GET /meta/action/NAME`、`/layers`、`/published`，以及进程内 `MetadataManager.get('action', NAME)`）时，现在把"不属于任何包的同名动作"也算作持有者。只有一个包同名时，环境自己建的动作先答；平台代码注册的同名动作，和包的动作并存时返回 409，两个都点名；两个及以上包同名时，409 也会点名这个无包动作。
- 另外修了一处：一个被停用的包先注册、启用的包后注册时，按名读取以前返回"没有条目"，`/layers` 甚至返回停用包的内容；现在两处都返回启用包的动作。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 D3 规定不带包名的调用方先拿环境自己的项，再拿唯一的包持有者，否则拒绝并点名全部候选。以前这几种情况要么在两者之间随意挑一个，要么拒绝时漏掉候选，要么读不到实际存在的动作。
- 风险与回滚：第一方组合里没有和包内动作同名的无包动作，本仓库所有应答不变。`/actions/:object/:name` 路由的声明读取（execution 面）遇到无包项时保持 main 的答案，由 owner seat 另行跟进；停用包先注册的情况下，路由现在能拿到启用包的声明。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts` 的 `judgeBareActionRead`，以及 `packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts` 的 `readStoreEntry` / `refuseAcrossOwners`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local src/action-package-addressing.test.ts -t 32365`，预期 21 例全过（第 1 轮的 14 例在 main 上有 10 例红）。

Fixes #32365

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — narrowing: a by-name read naming no package of an action name (`GET /meta/action/NAME`, its `/layers` and its `/published`, on both transports) beside a package-less item the environment's store holds no row of (the platform's: host code or a plugin) and one or more enabled package holders goes from 200 (the platform's item) to 409 naming every package and the platform; beside two or more enabled packages the 409 names the package-less holder too (the environment or the platform), where it named the packages only, and so does the refusal of `MetadataManager.get('action', NAME)` (as the environment), wherever the package-less item sits. Widening: where a disabled package registered before the one enabled holder, the plain read goes from 200 with no item to the enabled holder's item, and the `/actions` route of that holder's object from no declaration to its own. Moved answers (same status, the rule's holder in place of another): that case's `/layers` from the disabled package's body to the enabled holder's; `/layers` beside the environment's own item and one package from the package's item to the environment's; `MetadataManager.get('action', NAME)` there from the item written last to the package-less item; `MetadataManager.get('action', NAME, P)`, and with it step 2 of `GET /meta/action/NAME?package=P`, from the item written last to P's own.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` teach no bare read of an action name a package-less item shares with a package; the prescription ships in the refusal text and in the FROM → TO below.

## What changes

Step 0 measured each case on `origin/main` `89d815c5` and on #32497's head `1483899c`. The two outputs are byte-identical, so #32497 covers none of the three cases.

| # | state (no package named) | read | FROM (main) | TO | arm |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | env row on `contact` + A on `account` | `GET /meta/action/NAME` | 200 env | 200 env (unchanged) | — |
| 1 | same | `/layers` (code layer) | 200 **A's** item | 200 env | moved answer |
| 1 | same | `MetadataManager.get` | the slot written last (env or A) | env | moved answer |
| 1 | platform item (no row) on `contact` + A on `account` | get, `/layers`, `/published` (both transports) | 200 platform | 409 `[A, platform]` | narrowing |
| 2 | A on `account` + B on `contact` + package-less on `lead` (or all object-less) | get, `/layers`, `/published` (both transports) | 409 `[A, B]` | 409 `[A, B, environment]` (`platform` with no row) | narrowing (candidate added) |
| 2 | A + B (two objects, or one object) + package-less on another object, or on the packages' key, in the service store | `MetadataManager.get` | 409 `[A, B]` | 409 `[A, B, environment]` | narrowing (candidate added) |
| 3 | B disabled registered first + A enabled (two objects, one object, object-less) | get | 200, **no item** | 200 A | widening |
| 3 | same | `POST /actions/<A's object>/NAME` declaration | none | A's | widening |
| 3 | same | `/layers` (code layer) | 200 **B's (disabled) body** | 200 A | moved answer |
| — | env on another object written after A's | `MetadataManager.get('action', NAME, A)`, and so step 2 of `GET /meta/action/NAME?package=A` | env (written last) | A's own | moved answer |

"Moved answer": same status, the rule's holder's item in place of another holder's.

**The fix.**

1. **Protocol judge (`protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`, `judgeBareActionRead`).** It replaces `refuseActionHeldByPackages` at the plain read and the layered read. It judges the registry's enabled package holders together with its package-less bare-slot entry. When the environment's store holds an active package-less row of the name on the same object key (or none), that entry is the environment's own item, and it answers beside one package holder. Without such a row it is the platform's item, which is refused beside any package holder. Beside two or more holders it is named in the refusal. With one enabled holder and nothing package-less, the answer is that holder's item (`getPackageScopedItem`), never the registry's first composite. Step 3 serves the answer in place of `getItem`'s. The layered read's code layer reads the same answer: the artifact at the one holder, or the environment's runtime item.
2. **Refusal text.** `refuseActionHeldByPackages` takes the package-less holder as a fourth argument, adds its candidate, and appends a sentence naming its object. Each package's object is read from its own item (`holderOwnItem`), never from a package-less entry the registry binds to it.
3. **In process (`package-slotted-store.ts`).** `readStoreEntry` with no package answers the package-less slot first beside one package. `refuseAcrossOwners` names the environment beside two packages. `readIdentity` names the environment when two packages share one action identity, whether the package-less slot is on that identity or on another object. A read naming package P answers P's own slot first.
4. **The metadata service's answer.** The service is read before the registry and holds its own copies. For a bare action read its answer is served (the plain read's step 2, and the `/layers` code layer) only when it fits the judged answer (`serviceAnswerFitsBareAction`). Both are read as the store reads them, through `storedItemPackageId` (the stored envelope's `packageId`, flat or under the publish envelope, else the body's stamp). The copy fits when it is the judged holder's own. A package-less copy fits a judged package (its customization), and fits the environment's judged item only when it binds the same object (`boundObjectOf`). Anything else gives way to the judged answer: another package's copy, such as a disabled package's or the one package's beside the environment's own item, and a package's customization on its own object beside the environment's item. The two readers are published from `@objectstack/metadata` as a new lean entry, `@objectstack/metadata/stored-item-package`.
5. **`rethrowPackageScopedRefusal`** counts only enabled packages. So a store refusal that also names the environment falls through to the judge when fewer than two enabled packages remain.

**Execution face (seat ruling B).** The `/actions/:object/:name` route's declaration read (`getMetaItemForExecution`) keeps main's answer beside a package-less item. The served read and the route's declaration read therefore do not yet agree there; the owner seat follows that up separately. Measured route answers are identical to main in cases 1 and 2. In case 3 the enabled holder's route now gets its declaration (see the table).

**Epic note 6798747403 (the heal's question), seat ruling.** After a refused package-less heal, the removed row's entry left in the registry's bare slot is to be **retired**: no baseline is registered, and the bare read falls back to the store's 409 naming every holder. The heal lives in `protocol-registry-hydration.ts`, which is on #32447 and not on `main`, so this PR does not touch it (carrier: #32447). Pinned within this card: with such a stale package-less entry and no composite holder, while the service store holds two packages, the bare read answers the store's 409 naming both, never the stale entry.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts`, `[#32365]` (21 cases).
  - Case 1: the environment's item on another object, in both registration orders, and object-less. The platform's item is refused on both reads. Route `contact` keeps main's answer.
  - Case 2: refused naming A, B and the environment, on two objects and all object-less. Routes `contact` and `lead` answer as on main.
  - Case 3: three shapes, plain and layered, and the enabled holder's route. CONTROL enabled-first. CONTROL one holder.
  - Over a real `MetadataManager`: the env item answers whichever was written last; the store refusal names the environment; the epic-note pin.
  - Over a real `MetadataManager`, `/layers` with code and overlay asserted apart: case 1 with the service holding A's item only (env answers both reads); case 3 with the service holding the disabled B's item only (A answers both); case 3 with the service holding both (A).
  - [N1] The service's copy under the publish envelope (the package only on the wrapped body's stamp): case 1 answers env and case 3 answers A, code layer included. A's customization (a package-less body the store keeps in A's slot, on `account`) beside the environment's item answers env. CONTROL: with A alone, its customization answers both reads.
  - CONTROL disabled B: pinned to A's item, the current answer. The environment's item there is in the service store only and the registry's judge does not see it; the follow-up card carries it.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts`, `#32365` (3 cases): the same moves through `RestServer`, on the item read (`details.candidates`), `/layers` and `/published`.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts`, `#32365` (3 cases): the dispatcher's item read, `/layers` and `/published` for the platform arm and the candidate-added arm, and case 3's item read.
- `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-action-slots.test.ts`, `[#32365]` (5 cases): the environment first in either write order, with `?package=A` answering A's own slot; the refusal names the environment on two objects, on one key, and beside two packages on one object with the environment's item on another; CONTROL a package-less item on the one package's own key is its customization.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts`: the layered code layer's call site is re-recorded (same disposition, now at the judged holder).
- **Red first:** the round-1 pins ran against `main` `89d815c5`: runtime 10 of 14 red, rest 3 of 3 red, metadata 3 of 4 red, every CONTROL green. Round 2: the dispatcher and REST `#32365` pins against `main`'s three source files are 3 of 3 red each; the new store pin is red at the previous head `62223e19`.
- **Ablation (round 1, once):** the plain read's judge put back to main's `refuseActionHeldByPackages(host, request.name, objectLessRefused)`. Predicted: the platform, case 2 and case 3 pins red, and the env-first plain read green. Observed: 6 red, 8 green. Restored: blob equal.
- **Red first (round 3, N1):** the three N1 pins red at `f374e3ce`, the CONTROL green.
- **Ablation (round 2, once):** the service-answer check removed from both reads. Predicted: the case 1 and case 3 service-only pins red, the service-holds-both pin green. Observed: 2 red, 1 green. Restored and rebuilt.

Each was run with its exit code recorded before any pipe. 81 exited 0. `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: its fixture is pinned to a commit a shallow clone cannot reach, and it exits 3 on untouched `main` here too. `--ran`: 82 derived, 81 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

  - `metadata-protocol`: 336 files passed, 7 skipped; 22738 tests passed, 36 skipped.
  - `runtime`: 581 files, 9922 tests passed, 19 skipped.

## Acceptance notes

- **Shared files with seat 1's chain** (`git diff --name-only` against each branch, trial merges):
  - `claude/project-thread-3giljf` (27abd458), `wqgmuu` (0ecd1ff4), `du44hj` (a9779e0f): `packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`; `wqgmuu` also `metadata-manager-action-slots.test.ts`. Trial merge: 0 conflicts each.
  - `claude/project-thread-phk4r9` (#32497, 1483899c): `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`, `rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts`, `runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts`. The trial merge (round 1) conflicted only in the REST test file (both append a describe at the end) and in two files this PR does not touch. Landing order: seat 1 agreed this lands before #32497; the order against #32566 (shared `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`) is the seats' call.
  - #32352's PR #32533 is now on `main` and merged here (see Gates). Its removal and this read count holders by package; the remaining differences are carried on #32560.
- **Census:** no first-party composition registers a package-less action under a package's action name. `examples/**` ships two `*.action.ts` files with distinct names and seeds no `sys_metadata` action row. No answer changes in this repository.
- **Surface beyond the card:** `MetadataManager.get('action', NAME, P)` now answers P's own slot first (it answered the slot written last), which the env-first pin needed. `@objectstack/metadata` gains the lean entry `./stored-item-package` (`storedItemPackageId`, `boundObjectOf`; `boundObjectOf` was module-private). `refuseActionHeldByPackages` keeps its exported signature and adds an optional fourth argument.
- **Follow-up:** filed #32560. It carries the in-process platform-vs-environment split, the loaders' slots after an in-memory hit, the service-only environment item the judge does not see, the "held by N packages" wording, and alignment with #32533's removal.
